title: Starter: Maths Mela
summary: Grade 5: big numbers and the Indian place-value system, fractions, angles as turns, measuring and converting, symmetry, and reading data and maps.

ib.globalContext: PYP theme: How we organise ourselves
ib.statementOfInquiry: Numbers, shapes and measures help us describe, compare and organise the world around us.

factual: How do we read numbers in lakhs?
How many degrees are in a full turn?
conceptual: Why do we need standard units to measure?
debatable: Is it better to estimate or to measure exactly?
